rule: ตก has sixteen senses off one motion, falling, and the trick is that its CORE was empty — plain physical falling had no compounds at all, though half this list is exactly that: ดาวตก, ตะวันตก, ตกตะกอน, ตกผลึก, เก็บตก, เก็บข้าวตก, ตกกล้า, and ตกหลุม / ตกหลุมพราง, which mean being deceived but are still someone dropping into a pit. Sense 2, flowing or dripping down, was also empty and takes น้ำตก and ตกมัน, the oil running at an elephant's temple. After that the senses are read off the gloss: an undesirable state (ตกงาน, สอบตก) is 6, arriving or coming through is 7 (ตกทอด, ตกเบิก), coming out is 8 (ตกกระ), going missing is 9 (ตกค้าง), dropping low from fear or exhaustion is 11 (ตกใจ, จิตตก), completion is 12 (ตกแต่ง), the hook is 13 (ตกเบ็ด) and the lure is 14 (ตกทอง).

notes.text:
**ตก — the core sense was empty.** Sixteen senses off one motion, and plain
physical falling had no compounds at all, though nine of the twenty-six are
exactly that: ดาวตก, ตะวันตก, ตกตะกอน, ตกผลึก, เก็บตก, เก็บข้าวตก, ตกกล้า, and
ตกหลุม / ตกหลุมพราง, which mean being deceived but are still someone dropping
into a pit. Sense 2, flowing down, was also empty and takes น้ำตก and ตกมัน, the
oil running at a bull elephant's temple.
